title: 普朗克·橘子时间
description: 海盗船长普朗克穿厚实长外套，在码头凳上剥橘子，弯刀入鞘、手枪收好。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Gangplank is a rugged adult pirate captain with a thick dark beard, weathered face, broad hat, long red-brown coat, and recognizable mechanical arm details. Keep his fully closed shirt, opaque trousers, heavy boots, and layered belts. His curved cutlass remains sheathed and his pistol secured in a closed holster, with no aiming, smoke, or active weapon handling.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a sturdy dockside bench and patiently peels one orange over a small wooden plate. A neat curl of peel hangs from his fingers, and a little gull watches from a separate post. Show only a calm moored boat and one coil of rope behind him, turning the pirate theme into an unhurried snack break.
art_direction.palette: coat rust, navy blue, orange peel, weathered cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
